survey: A wooden barrel stands upright on a wooden plank floor in front of a yellow wall. The camera is a little above the barrel, looking slightly down. The lid is an open ellipse seen from above, and its planks run left to right inside the rim. The four iron hoops all bow downward in the middle, and the lower hoops bow a little more, which matches a camera above them. Each hoop has a rivet centred on the front. The staves are vertical, follow the barrel's bulge, and get somewhat narrower toward the left and right edges as the surface turns away. The barrel's axis is vertical and the shape is symmetric. The bottom hoop sits just above the base, which rests flat on the floor and casts a shadow to the right. The floor planks run diagonally from lower left to upper right and read as a surface seen from above, below an eye level that sits above the barrel lid. The line where the wall meets the floor is close to horizontal and well below eye level. The lid, hoops, staves and floor all agree on one raised viewpoint.
